holdout: One midgame board per finished 2025 public classical game. Test tournament families excluded from both fitting groups. No recorded game move or historic evaluation enters the holdout ranker.

repeatReference.recheck: Repeat all held-out boards. Match the exact stronger move, weaker move, refuting reply, mechanism and original target when judging repeatable positives.

criterion: One alternative per board. Compare positive counts and known competitive alternatives, stratified by tournament. Unknowns consume a slot. A model earns a second prospective experiment if it gains at least two repeated witnesses in at least two tournament families over the best simple method at the same budget, without more competitive alternatives.
scope: Engine-witness samples. A positive is a concrete branch contrast under the recorded searches. A competitive alternative is a control for the contrast. Neither outcome labels a player's thinking or the full position.
